title: LibreCAD_3 clean origin/master compatibility probe

sources.sourceMode: git archive of origin/master; no dirty LibreCAD_3 working-tree content was used

configuration.buildResult: PASS; current libdxfrw compiled as a subdirectory and LibreCAD_3 persistence linked

initial.finding: LibreCAD_3 DXFimpl::writeHeader supplied $INSUNITS for R12/R14 targets in both preserved-header and default-header paths. libdxfrw correctly refuses the unsupported variable before AC1015, so the adapter made otherwise representable 2D drawings fail to save.

scratchFixes.change: Emit $INSUNITS only when the selected export version is newer than AC1014, in both preserved and default header paths.
Remove the non-null group-330 owner from the first OBJECTS DICTIONARY. The reader correctly refuses an owned first dictionary instead of misclassifying it as the root named-object dictionary.
scratchFixes.status: COMMITTED on consumerPatchBranch; only pre-existing LibreCAD_3 DXF fixtures were corrected

implementation.commitSubject: Fix LibreCAD DXF exports for legacy versions

interpretation: This records two LibreCAD_3 consumer/test-fixture changes, not a libdxfrw parser or writer defect. The patch is committed on a local LibreCAD_3 branch but is not merged into LibreCAD_3 origin/master. Keep the unsupported-version $INSUNITS refusal and first-root-DICTIONARY validation. The evidence is a macOS clean-consumer build and focused export/readback result only.
